g.aria-label: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM): u_t(x) = E[ u_t(x | z) | x_t = x ] Solves ∂_t p_t + ∇·(p_t u_t) = 0
Why Independent Pairing Bends: At t = 1, u₁(x) = x − E[x₀], so 1 Euler step collapses all points to E[x₀]!
When straight chords cross at (x, t), averaging their velocities creates a curved non-crossing ODE flow
